# Strategic product roadmap planning

Selected by Skill Harbor — short listing (the repo states no license, so no content is reproduced): @deanpeters's guided roadmap-planning workflow for product managers — 5 phases over 1–2 weeks: gather inputs (OKRs, customer problems, technical constraints, stakeholder requests), define epics as hypotheses with success metrics and T-shirt effort estimates, prioritize with RICE/ICE plus strategic overrides, sequence into Now/Next/Later quarters with dependency mapping and engineering validation, then present, gather feedback and publish — with a facilitation protocol (guided / context-dump / best-guess entry modes), numbered recommendations, and anti-patterns called out (feature factories, HiPPO prioritization, roadmap-as-contract waterfall thinking).
